tasks.goal: Patrol the Charter Hall perimeter path, stopping at each exhibit plinth displaying charter and contribution model content.
tasks.terrain: Polished exhibit hall floors with cable ramps near display plinths; threshold strips between gallery bays.
success: Visits all 5 plinth waypoints within +/-0.3 m
Completes tour under 12 min at <=0.8 m/s
Zero collisions (contact force sensor silent)
safety_stops: E-stop on person within 1.0 m of path
Stop if /scan shows obstacle under 0.5 m
Halt when battery below 20%
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward reviews the tour log and approves the updated exhibit-status summary before publication.

tasks.goal: Carry printed evidence summaries from the synthesis desks to the review rack near the Evidence Monitor station.
tasks.terrain: Low-pile carpet between bench rows; loose papers and rolling chairs as dynamic obstacles.
success: 8 deliveries completed with payload <=3 kg
Docking at rack within 0.15 m lateral error
No dropped-payload events detected
safety_stops: Stop on any detected ankle-height obstacle <0.4 m
Pause if payload shifts beyond tilt threshold
Sit and stop if battery <15%
tasks.human_in_loop: A researcher confirms each summary is correctly filed before the task is marked complete.

tasks.goal: Walk the microphones and printed proposal drafts from the drafting table to the human voting seats.
tasks.terrain: Tiered forum seating edges, AV floor boxes, and chair legs; smooth concrete floor with painted aisle lines to follow.
success: >=90% of line-follow segments kept centroid error <5 px
Item handover completed at each of 6 seats
Zero falls detected via IMU
safety_stops: Stop if IMU tilt exceeds 20 deg
Stop when a seated person reaches toward the tray
Low-battery sit-down at 15%
tasks.human_in_loop: Each voter acknowledges receipt of the draft; agents never enact or vote on proposals.

tasks.goal: Sort task-routing cards and Kanban tiles onto the working-group boards mounted above the coordination desk.
tasks.terrain: Desk-mounted cell with board rails at 1.2-1.8 m height; cable management tray along the desk edge as a known obstacle.
success: Placement error <5 mm on 12 tiles
Gripper force below 10 N throughout
Cycle time <15 s per tile
safety_stops: Stop if wrist wrench exceeds 40 N
Stop when a hand enters the workspace envelope via safety scanner
E-stop on unexpected joint-torque spike
tasks.human_in_loop: A coordinator approves the final board arrangement reflecting the routed tasks for the cycle.

tasks.goal: Fly a slow scan of the observatory's outcome dashboards to capture frame-accurate images for the Progress Tracker agent.
tasks.terrain: Indoor atrium with glass display cases causing optical-flow dropouts; ceiling beams at 6 m and hanging signage as no-fly obstacles.
success: Captures all 5 dashboards with blur metric below threshold
Holds each hover within +/-10 cm for 3 s
Maintains >=1.5 m clearance from glass and beams
safety_stops: Land immediately if battery <20%
Land if localization variance exceeds threshold near glass
Kill motors on optical-flow failure >1 s
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward verifies dashboard images and approves their use in the progress report.

tasks.goal: Inspect the exterior walkway between the Operations Deck loading area and the riverside utility shed along the Zumbro River bank.
tasks.terrain: Gravel and brick riverside path; damp grass verges sloping to the Zumbro River, bollards, and occasional geese as dynamic obstacles.
success: Covers 150 m of path with 100% thermal+RGB coverage
Maintains >=2 m standoff from water edge
Return-to-dock within 0.3 m
safety_stops: Stop if terrain slope estimate exceeds 30 deg
Stop when wildlife detected within 3 m
Sit and abort if leak/moisture fault or battery <20%
tasks.human_in_loop: A facilities staffer reviews inspection footage and approves before any maintenance ticket is opened.

tasks.goal: Retrieve archived charter-measurement binders from the tiered archive shelf and deliver them to the reading desk.
tasks.terrain: Archive aisle 0.9 m wide; binder spines at 0.6-1.5 m shelf heights; anti-fatigue mats that perturb base odometry.
success: 6 of 6 correct binders picked (barcode verified)
Grasp success on first attempt >=80%
No shelf contact events during arm motion
safety_stops: Stop arm if external wrench >25 N
Pause base motion when a person enters the aisle
Abort if depth sensor loses shelf plane >2 s
tasks.human_in_loop: An archivist confirms binder IDs and logs the retrieval; archive policy changes remain human-governed.
